mods.name: Extra Backpack
mods.description: An optional native 20-slot extra backpack for every character class.
mods.author: zj1022

mods.name: Currency Loot
mods.description: Adds configurable bonus rolls for specific currencies on monster kills.
mods.author: zj1022

mods.name: Exciting Items
mods.description: Rare chances on magic, rare and unique drops: a unique item's modifier as an extra implicit, an empowered modifier 10-100% above its roll, and one modifier more than the item could have, fractured with its side; they can all land on one item.
mods.author: marshmellion

mods.name: Fast Campaign
mods.description: A faster campaign: 5x kill experience, +50% movement speed, and /fast lists the commands that skip ahead.
mods.author: LocalExile

mods.name: Global Chat
mods.description: Talk to other LocalExile players: global, trade and whisper chat go through the LocalExile global chat server.
mods.author: JetStream

mods.name: GM Commands
mods.description: The development and testing chat commands: teleport, items, monsters, experience, quest flags, test hits and protocol probes.
mods.author: LocalExile

mods.name: Heart of the Grove
mods.description: The 3.13 Heart of the Grove: on rare occasions a map's Sacred Grove holds Oshabi's encounter instead of crops.
mods.author: mrnamwen

mods.name: Idols
mods.description: Legacy of Phrecia's Idols: items with map modifiers that affect every map you open while they lie in the Idol inventory.
mods.author: mrnamwen

mods.name: Item Quantity
mods.description: 10 times as many item drops from every kill.
mods.author: LocalExile

mods.name: Item Rarity
mods.description: 10 times the chance of magic, rare and unique equipment.
mods.author: LocalExile

mods.name: Live Economy
mods.description: Faustus's Currency Exchange as a live market: the official Path of Exile leagues' prices, a spread, depth, and orders that fill with time.
mods.author: JetStream

mods.name: Map Drop
mods.description: Adds configurable bonus map drops in Atlas maps and optionally in the late campaign.
mods.author: zj1022

mods.name: Nessa's development tabs
mods.description: Nessa sells Awakened Gems, Exceptional Gems, Maps, Originator Maps and Unique Maps in the leagues that list this mod.
mods.author: evrydayjunglist

mods.name: Pet Loot
mods.description: Worn pets collect selected currency with per-character filters and an immediate pause switch.
mods.author: zj1022

mods.name: Phrecia ascendancies
mods.description: Legacy of Phrecia's alternate ascendancy classes and the Phrecia league, which also needs the idols mod.
mods.author: shimonshi

mods.name: Player bots
mods.description: Server-driven characters that play the campaign, visit the towns and can join a party, so a server feels lived in.
mods.author: nikolos89

mods.name: POB
mods.description: Preview and import a character build through a configured external PoB converter.
mods.author: nikolos89

mods.name: Skip Campaign
mods.description: Adds an opt-in Skip Campaign toggle to character creation (with NativeMods) and /skipcampaign fallback so eligible characters start directly in Karui Shores with campaign quest flags, passive books, Kitava penalties, waypoints, refund points, and ascendancy trials applied.
mods.author: mrnamwen

mods.name: Survivors
mods.description: The Survivors league: survive the horde; skills cast themselves, and each run level offers an upgrade.
mods.author: GafGafGaf5612

mods.name: Waypoint Tools
mods.description: Lets Waypoint's tools reach the game without the client control bridge: the item crafter gives its items through it.
mods.author: Waypoint

mods.name: Zoom
mods.description: A wider view in normal play: the camera stands further back, and /zoom sets how far.
mods.author: evrydayjunglist
